name: black_grass

source.seeds_init_m2: [AS] Alopecurus myosuroides, an autumn-germinating grass weed of German cereals. A moderately infested field; the seedbank halves in about a year in the top layer (persistence of 2-3 years, recalled from the black-grass literature, no document in hand).
